value.rationale: Canonical minimally imperfect graphs have a natural competition between clique and rank facets. This infinite-family metric theorem gives the exact unique Euclidean inball, a sharp mixed contact transition at the 9-vertex odd antihole (19 of 22 facets tangent), and a complete shell multiplicity formula for every facet. The established inequality description alone does not state these metric facts; the result serves geometric comparisons of stable-set polytopes.
